_comment: BRANCH-SPECIFIC. On main this file builds the app in app/. On the site
branch it serves the marketing page in site/ instead, because Vercel's
Root Directory picker only lists folders that exist on the default
branch — and site/ is not on main, so it cannot be selected there.
Pointing the repository root at site/ is the way round that.
If this branch is ever merged into main, DO NOT bring this file with it:
keep main's version, which builds the app, and give the site its own
Vercel project with Root Directory set to site.
buildCommand: echo 'the site has no build step'
